question.text: Although $\mathrm{CN}^{-}$ion and $\mathrm{N}_2$ molecule are isoelectronic, yet $\mathrm{N}_2$ molecule is chemically inert because of

options.text: presence of more number of electrons in bonding orbitals

solution.text: In nitrogen molecule, both the nitrogen atoms have same electronegativity. So it has zero polarity and hence less tendency to break away and form ions.
